brief: Trial NCT03433703 (Eisai, phase 2). Why did it stop and how many people were enrolled? Were results posted?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03433703 stopped because "Study recruitment was stopped due to difficulty in enrolling the targeted number of participants.", categorized as enrollment.
findings.notes: Exact quote from registry why_stopped field.
Snapshot and live record enrollment count.

findings.claim: Results were posted for trial NCT03433703 on ClinicalTrials.gov on December 6, 2019.
The intervention drug Lenvatinib has been approved by the FDA under NDA206947 by Eisai Inc. on February 13, 2015.

tool_calls.name: get_trial_live
tool_calls.result: NCT03433703: TERMINATED, why_stopped='Study recruitment was stopped due to difficulty in enrolling the targeted number'

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.enrollment, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, d.results_due_date, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03433703'
